menu_options.serial: USB or serial port of this computer

tcp.title: KISS TCP
tcp.description: Host and port of a KISS TCP server, for example the bridge on the machine the radio is plugged into, Direwolf or a TNC with network access. The connection is retried until it works, so the radio may be switched on later.

serial.title: USB or serial port
serial.description: Pick the port the radio is plugged into. If it is not listed, plug the radio in and open this step again, or type the path.

data_description.device: Best is the /dev/serial/by-id/… name: it stays the same when the radio is plugged in again.
data_description.baudrate: USB radios (such as a Quansheng with the KISS TNC) ignore the speed; leave 115200.

data_description.callsign: For example OK1SIM-7. Transmitting needs an amateur radio licence and stays off until you switch it on.
data_description.path: WIDE1-1,WIDE2-1 is usual for APRS; empty for direct only.

send_message.name: Send APRS message
send_message.description: Sends a message and repeats it until the recipient acknowledges it.

via.name: Via
via.description: Radio only, the internet (APRS-IS) only, or both. Default: both.

send_position.description: Sends a position packet, Home Assistant's home by default.

send_unproto.name: Send unproto text
send_unproto.description: Sends plain text in a UI frame, like a classic TNC in unproto mode.
